title: Jagged Juicy Canadian Corn Wrap
description: A flexitarian-friendly Canadian dish featuring miso-marinated ingredients wrapped in a corn husk, with a sour and shattering texture from the crunchy corn and tangy slaw. This one-pot meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large pot, combine minced garlic and miso paste, cooking over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add canadian bacon to the pot, cooking until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add shredded red cabbage and grated carrots to the pot, cooking until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together apple cider vinegar and 2 tablespoons of water, then pour the mixture over the cabbage and carrots.
Reduce heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, prepare the corn husks by soaking them in water for 5 minutes, then wrapping each one around a portion of the mixture.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with additional shredded cabbage and carrots if desired.
